d:
The Pistons defeated the Spurs, 105-93 tonight in San Antonio. Cade Cunningham contributed a team-high 27 points to go with 6 assists and 5 rebounds, with Daniss Jenkins of the Pistons adding an additional 25 points (11-21 FG, 3-7 3P) in the game. Victor Wembanyama finished with a team-high 25 points along with 18 rebounds for the Spurs in the losing effort. The Pistons improve their record to 9-4 with the win, while the Spurs fall to 12-3 for the season.
